**Allowance on loans receivable and investments:** The $28.8 million change in 2022 versus 2021 was mainly due to a $20.0 million allowance recognized in 2022 on the Santerre Mezzanine Loan to Santerre Health Investors [4]. The loan has a current principal balance of $486.1 million and is priced at LIBOR + 6.42% [4]. The allowance was calculated under the CECL model [8]. The change was partially offset by the reversal of certain allowances in Q1 2021, following a change in the estimate of credit losses [4].

**Other expenses:** Other expenses rose $21.2 million in 2022 over 2021 [4]. This was primarily due to a $24.0 million increase in unrealized loss from a decrease in the fair value of the stock warrants received in connection with the Brookdale Senior Living lease modification [4].
